definition.//: Decision D5 (eval/study/README.md decision log; memo eval/study/TIER-ADMISSION.md), recorded 2026-11-06 by the lead and approved by the founder the same day, before any held-out census. Rule 5's tier (pre-registered 2026-11-05) with two changes: passes_key and renders move from the default to the suggestion tier, and a default-tier rule must name no symbol from outside the repository (default.target "in_repo": no pkg:, global# or unresolved: wrapper, decorator, base class or callee, and no import: avoidance of one; lib.mjs namesPackage, drift_mine::tier::names_package). A package object reached through a binding the repository defines has an in-repo id and counts as in-repo. DEFAULT tier = structured rule kind (lib.mjs ruleKind) in default.rule_kinds AND the rule names no symbol from outside the repository AND its role has >= default.min_members members. SUGGESTION tier = every other shown proposal. The not-wrong rate is reported over all shown proposals, both tiers. Written verbatim into both primary manifests on 2026-11-06, before any held-out census, and registered in holdout-manifests.json amendments.

default.//: call wrappers, decorators, base classes, layering (import avoidance), rendered inside a (layout) wrapper; each only when every symbol it names is defined in the repository (not a package, a built-in or global, or unresolved)

suggestion.//: rule 5's suggestion kinds, plus required argument keys and rendered components (D5). Default-tier kinds whose rule names a package, built-in or unresolved symbol are suggestion tier too.

target.criterion: met when the point estimate, per language, is ≥ 95% (decision D1, 2026-11-05)

not_wrong_target.criterion: met when the point estimate, per language, is ≥ 95% (decision D4, 2026-11-05)
